    </div>

    <div class="op-about-text">
      <p class="op-quote">A data leader with a physicist's habits: careful with measurement, wary of any single number, and most interested in the decision a model is meant to serve.</p>
      <p>My last two roles have been in political and civic data, first at the Democratic National Committee and now leading data at Hockeystick, where the work connects campaigns and organisations with the people who support them. It is the work I want to keep doing.</p>
      <p>I trained in astrophysics at the University of Edinburgh, and my research on sampling for Mars missions was published in Nature Astronomy. I am now completing a Master's in Data Science at UC Berkeley.</p>
      <p>Outside work I am usually kayaking, reading, making art, or at home with my husband and our three cats.</p>
